crop.notes: The whole 'From Jacksonville, Ill.' correspondence letter; only the 'A Professional Pugilist' paragraph near the end mentions Allen.

ocr.notes: Allen paragraph mostly readable; other sections of the letter have many garbled lines.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican's Jacksonville, Illinois correspondent reported that the English pugilist Patsey Reardon, who had recently challenged Tom Allen through a St. Louis paper, was in town proposing a sparring exhibition.

metadata.notes: Page masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, August 18, 1869.' Letter dated Jacksonville, August 17.

facts.fact: Patsey Reardon, an Irish-born pugilist who had fought in England, published a challenge to fight Allen in a St. Louis paper
